title: 新たなチャレンジだべ！

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowzers! Look at all those rides! The city really is amaz'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Yukino Bijin's request, we've come to check out an amusement park in the city.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There're so many people—it's practic'lly a festival! This is someth'n else!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's all that hubbub over there about? Is everyone flock'n to a new swanky ride?

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text: Stop dodging the question! You actually want to get back into racing, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Actor B
text_block_list.text: You came all the way here just to ask me about racing? …Come on, you can't just tell people how they should feel about something!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer! Are they film'n a TV show right now?! I've seen those actors b'fore!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hot dog! They're even more dazzl'n in real life!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And it's not just 'bout their looks and mannerisms—it's the way they're so poised! And d'termined to really step into their roles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just can't take my peepers off 'em… Even from this far away, they're just plain mesmeriz'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's a pair of bona fide city girls right there! And someday… I'll be one too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin's expression changes. She still looks happy, but her eyes seem to twinkle with her hopes and dreams.
choice_data_list: Do you want to try acting too?
Do you want to try acting too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?! I mean, I do wanna be like them—enchant'n inside and out…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And if I could act onstage right alongside 'em, I bet that'd get me closer to the glitz and glam of a city girl too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But… there's noth'n special about me, so all that's just wishful think'n. Haha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Yukino Bijin shrinks back a little, the words she spoke a minute ago come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Someday… I'll be one too…" Is she really that far away from realizing that dream? At the very least, she's closer than she thinks…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure she could manage a minor role with only a few lines and appearances…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hi there. I've brought what you asked for, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Your trainer asked if there were any small roles open in any TV shows.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I picked out a few. Do you want to go through them with me, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Personally, I think the last one—the student—would be best for you. It's easier to play a role you can relate to.
choice_data_list: Yeah. I think this one would be good for you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You want me?! on TV?! What?! Have you two both gone cuckoo?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You want to act, don't you? I know you've got what it takes, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There's no way! I mean, I'm interested, sure, b-but there's no way I'm good 'nuff!
choice_data_list: That's not true! I have total faith in you!
I'd love to see you in a TV show.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You do?
choice_data_list: Of course! I know you'll put in the effort to make it work!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Being an actor is about more than just looking good. It's a profession that actually involves lots of hard work and commitment.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's why I think you'd be suited to it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer… City…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I… I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll step up to the plate and knock ev'ryone's socks off with my act'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Presented with an opportunity to act on TV, Yukino Bijin vows to give the performance all she's got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having made up her mind, Yukino Bijin's eyes burn with determination.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! I can't even picture it!
choice_data_list: I just know it'll be a great show!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You keep putting yourself down, but I really think you've got what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And I'm a model, so you should know my word counts for something.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uh… Um!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If you're going to be a city girl, I'm pretty sure you'll need both confidence and experience, so how about it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I s'pose you're right…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I can't chicken out if I wanna be a real city girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Get me on that TV show! I'm gonna buckle right down and make you two proud as peacocks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Presented with an opportunity to act on TV, Yukino Bijin vows to give the performance all she's got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summoning all her courage, she's ready to take on this brand-new challenge.
